Verses.19: So we have the prophetic word made more sure. A word which you do well to pay attention to, like a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.
Verses.20: But above all, know this. No prophecy of Scripture came to be out of the prophet's own interpretation.
Verses.21: For prophecy was never made by an act of human will, but people spoke from God as they were moved by the Holy Spirit.

Changes: 2025-03-03 - Paul Prins: First translation of verses 19-21.
